questions.stem: Arrange the following set of numbers in increasing order: \(-\frac{3}{4}, -\frac{5}{6}, -\frac{9}{10}, \frac{10}{11}\)
questions.solution:
Let's convert each number to a decimal to compare their sizes:

  • \(-\frac{9}{10} = -0.900\)
  • \(-\frac{5}{6} \approx -0.833\)
  • \(-\frac{3}{4} = -0.750\)
  • \(\frac{10}{11} \approx 0.909\)

Comparing the values:

\(-0.900 < -0.833 < -0.750 < 0.909\)

Hence, the increasing order is:

\(-\frac{9}{10}, -\frac{5}{6}, -\frac{3}{4}, \frac{10}{11}\)

questions.stem: Arrange the following set of numbers in increasing order: \(-\frac{5}{4}, -\frac{12}{5}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{5}{2}\)
questions.solution:
Let's convert each number to a decimal:

  • \(-\frac{12}{5} = -2.4\)
  • \(-\frac{5}{4} = -1.25\)
  • \(\frac{1}{3} \approx 0.333\)
  • \(\frac{5}{2} = 2.5\)

Comparing the values:

\(-2.4 < -1.25 < 0.333 < 2.5\)

Hence, the increasing order is:

\(-\frac{12}{5}, -\frac{5}{4}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{5}{2}\)
